text:
rhea: heads-up — trying the docker-compose quickstart (mac + VPN) and my firstcall fails with a cryptic "Tenant not authorized". local node run worked.

ton y: can you paste the raw response? is it a 403 or 401?

rhea: 403 + body shows tenant_blocked. no further info. UI just shows retry.

kevin: VPN can block the cloud metadata endpoint we use for auto-detect and also prevent the quickstart from reading ~/.redwood/env. any reason you didn’t pass an env-file?

rhea: i was expecting compose to pick up .env automatically — i ran `docker compose up` from the repo root. i didn't realize our sample expects REDWOOD_ORG explicitly.

infra-sam: ok that’s two separate DX problems: 1) quickstart silently falls back to anonymous routing when env not provided 2) gateway returns tenant_blocked with no actionable hint. both are annoying.

rhea: exactly. took me a while to diff headers between local curl and the container.

tony: propose rapid fixes: - add a preflight script in the quickstart repo that prints the effective env and exits with non-zero if neither REDWOOD_ORG nor X-Redwood-Org present - make SDK append a short hint when tenant_blocked and no org header found (avoid changing structured API).

kevin: sample preflight idea: `./preflight.sh` which runs inside container on startup and prints something like:
```bash
#!/usr/bin/env bash
if [ -z "$REDWOOD_ORG" ] && [ -z "$X_REDWOOD_ORG" ]; then
  echo "ERROR: No workspace configured. Set REDWOOD_ORG or pass --env-file. See https://console.redwood.ai/workspaces for billing settings."
  exit 1
fi
```

infra-sam: also add a quick note about common causes: compose auto-env gotcha, Codespaces/CircleCI not copying local files, VPN blocking metadata IP, and Docker Desktop file sharing quirks.

rhea: that preflight would have saved me 20 minutes. +1 to an inline hint in the error payload.

tony: for the SDK change, append: " Hint: set REDWOOD_ORG or X-Redwood-Org, or visit https://console.redwood.ai/workspaces/<id>/billing" when response.code == "tenant_blocked" and no org header was present. keep it as human text to avoid API schema changes.

kevin: we should also tweak the quickstart UI to not spin indefinitely and instead show a small alert card: "First call blocked — check REDWOOD_ORG and billing settings (link)". low priority but nice.

infra-sam: i'll open a tiny PR to add preflight.sh, update docker entrypoint to run it, and update README. tony, want to own the SDK change?

tonys: sure — i’ll add a unit test that simulates missing header and asserts the hint appears. also add a brief integration test for docker compose where REDWOOD_ORG is unset to catch regressions.

billing-bot: Notice: workspace wz-billing-12 needs billing contact. Admins visit https://console.redwood.ai/workspaces/wz-billing-12/billing to add payment/contact info.

rhea: thanks — after setting REDWOOD_ORG in the compose env file my container runs and i get the first successful call. sending a short note to onboarding docs: "If your first call fails, check REDWOOD_ORG and workspace billing".

devex: filing tasks: quickstart-preflight, sdk-hint-tenant-block, ui-firstcall-alert. linking PRs when created. great triage, all. :rocket:
